acceptance: Corpus validation rejects completed throughput bundles when len(stream_results) differs from integer run.streams, or config.streams when run.streams is absent; absent configured counts skip the check. The error names the bundle path and both counts. Failed and partial phases with truncated results do not hard-fail corpus validation solely for the count mismatch.

Explorer pipeline and local result import withhold Throughput@Size when a completed phase's configured count differs from stream_results length; pipeline entries use stream_count_mismatch when the primary exclusion would otherwise be missing_primary_metric. Failed and partial phases retain the phase-failure exclusion instead of being relabeled as a count mismatch.
Unit tests cover matching counts, absent configured counts, run.streams/config.streams mismatches, and failed/partial truncation across corpus validation and Explorer ranking/import behavior.

description: For completed throughput phases, compare configured --streams (run.streams, falling back to config.streams) with the number of recorded stream_results. Report a mismatch instead of ranking an invalid completed run. Failed or partial phases may legitimately record fewer streams and must be excluded by phase status rather than treated as configuration defects.
